messages.subject: Circular control update
parts:
Hello

I have set up a sliderInput and a dateRangeInput to update each other so a date can be picked by either of them. dateRangeInput then acts as a reactive source for conductors, eventually changing the plot (takes about a second).

If the slider is changed before the plot is updated, it starts changing back and forth in a feedback cycle like in this discussion.

Setting priorities of observers doesn't help, because it doesn't affect reactives. Is there any workaround for this problem? Thank you.
 
    observe({
        x = input$intSlider
        updateDateRangeInput(session, "intRange",
                             start = Sys.Date() + x[1],
                             end = Sys.Date() + x[2])
    })
   
    observe({
        x = input$intRange
        updateSliderInput(session, "intSlider",
                          value = c(as.numeric(x[1]) - as.numeric(Sys.Date()),
                                    as.numeric(x[2]) - as.numeric(Sys.Date())))
    })

messages.subject: Re: Circular control update
parts:
Apologies for such a late response.
Your suggestion works, thank you!
   
    observe(
        {
            x = input$intSlider
            y  = isolate(input$intRange)
            if ( (Sys.Date() + x[1]) == y[1] && (Sys.Date() + x[2]) == y[2]) return()
            updateDateRangeInput(

session, "intRange",
                start = Sys.Date() + x[1],
                end = Sys.Date() + x[2]
            )
        }
    )
   
    observe(
        {       
            x = input$intRange

y  = isolate(input$intSlider)
            if ( (Sys.Date() + y[1]) == x[1] && (Sys.Date() + y[2]) == x[2] ) return()
            updateSliderInput(

session, "intSlider",
                value = c(as.numeric(x[1]) - as.numeric(Sys.Date()),
                          as.numeric(x[2]) - as.numeric(Sys.Date()))
            )
        }
    )
